findings.text: unknown_key_paths() feeds its walk through _schema_view() (reckon/flight.py:382), which strips harness_home_files, harness_home_adjacent_files, sprint_recent_days and picker_reserved_lanes before the walk starts. An undeclared key inside one of those blocks is therefore neither refused at load nor reported, so a typo inside them is silently accepted and the function's own claim of every key path the running schema does not declare is false for those fields. Measured at head: a host layer carrying harness_home_files.codex[0].bogus_entry resolves with unknown_keys == [] and raises nothing, because _validate_harness_home_entries (reckon/flight.py:420) checks only path and keys. The top-level block names are deliberately excluded and documented; an entry-level key inside them is not.

The done-when asks for ruff format --check clean on the changed hand-written paths, and this file is not: at head ruff format --check reports 17 hunks and '1 file would be reformatted'. It is not this node's defect and it does not hold the node: the same file at the base revision carries the identical 33 complaint lines, and the node's own hunks (project_setup_commands.py:415, :427, :445) fall outside every format hunk, so the delta is zero. Recorded because the manifest reports the ruff half of the gate as a delta reading rather than as the literal clean state the done-when names; under the repository's own add-no-findings rule the delta reading is the correct one.
